grid.title: 1 — Electricity grid
grid.description: Prefer ONE method: separate import/export sensors, or a genuine signed grid sensor. Use instantaneous power in W or kW. With separate import/export, signed power can be left empty. A sensor that stays at zero during export does not describe both directions. Selected readings are not added together.

data_description.grid_power: Optional. Must change sign between import and export. This beta preserves the source convention; do not choose an energy counter in kWh.
data_description.grid_import: Power purchased from the grid, normally positive or zero. This is not total home consumption.
data_description.grid_export: Power sent to the grid. Negative source values are accepted and displayed as a positive magnitude.

solar.title: 2 — Solar production
solar.description: Choose total solar production power in W or kW. An existing calculated sum of inverter outputs is suitable. Do not choose daily energy in kWh or exported surplus. Leave empty if you have no solar installation.

home.title: 3 — Home consumption
home.description:
Home consumption includes every household load: water heater, EV, heating, refrigerator and other appliances, regardless of electricity origin. Electrical battery charging is separate. Units: W or kW, not kWh.

Home consumption = Solar + Grid − Battery charge + Battery discharge. Signed grid: positive import, negative export. With two sensors: Grid = Import − Export. Never subtract the water heater or add submeters again. Example: 2,000 W solar, 300 W export, 500 W battery charge → 1,200 W home consumption.

Use an existing sensor covering this total, or EMS calculation. PV and battery powers must be measured on the AC side of the same boundary. Declare every active battery. A grid exchange sensor alone does not measure total home loads with solar or storage.

data.home_boundary_confirmed: I confirm the same AC boundary for all balance readings
data.home_grid_mode: Grid representation used in the balance

data_description.home_power: Must include water heater, EV and all appliances. A meter covering all load circuits or a template implementing the balance is suitable. Correct an older template that subtracts water heating. Ignored in EMS calculation mode.
data_description.home_power_mode: Existing sensor: value used as-is. EMS calculation: Home consumption = solar + grid − charge + discharge, including water heating and EV. EMS sensor ID is preserved.
data_description.home_has_solar: Only for EMS calculation. When checked, solar power must be mapped. Do not uncheck to bypass missing readings on an actual solar installation.
data_description.home_has_storage: Only for EMS calculation. In the next step, declare every battery participating in daily exchanges as active, with BOTH charge and discharge. Backup means outside this daily balance. Active DC storage blocks the simple AC calculation.
data_description.home_boundary_confirmed: Check meter placement, double counting and AC-side battery power. Internal pack/DC power is not interchangeable with AC power. EMS calculation cannot be enabled without confirmation.
data_description.home_max_age_seconds: Default 300 s, checked every 30 s. Warn mode flags old sources without hiding the balance; Strict mode blocks them. Set 0 to disable age checks. Stable 0 W is a valid reading.
data_description.home_grid_mode: Auto preserves a complete Import/Export pair, otherwise uses signed grid. Only one representation enters the balance. Signed grid must report positive import and negative export; an import-only sensor is unsuitable.
data_description.home_freshness_policy: Observation Warn mode retains the balance with source-age warnings. Strict mode blocks after the timeout. Missing, invalid and unavailable readings always block calculation.

review.title: 6 — Review measurements

confirm.title: Save in observation mode
confirm.description:
{summary}

Confirming saves observation mappings. The eHome EMS view is added automatically to the sidebar once the integration loads and follows its settings. An administrator can create an independent editable copy from that view without YAML. Existing copies are never overwritten. No equipment is commanded. Animated flows and EMS daily balances remain to be developed. Settings reload without a full HA restart.

batteries.title: 4 — Storage
batteries.description:
Add your batteries, or continue without storage. Each battery has separate readings. Backup is the default role.

{summary}

add_battery.title: Add a battery
add_battery.description: Map at least one reading and give the battery a clear name. Missing readings can be left empty. Charge and discharge are distinct positive instantaneous powers. SOC is a percentage; remaining energy is the current stock, not a lifetime input counter.

data.name: Battery name
data.remaining_energy_is_stock: I confirm this sensor represents remaining stock even if HA class says total

data_description.name: Display name, for example Main battery or Backup battery.
data_description.role: Active: participates in daily exchanges. Backup: separate monitoring, outside the future active balance. Neither role sends commands.
data_description.coupling: AC: storage connected on the AC side. DC: monitoring is available, but the simple AC balance needs a topology adapter.
data_description.capacity_kwh: Declared usable capacity in kWh for the monitored system. This is neither power in W nor remaining energy. Example: 8.2 kWh.
data_description.charge_power: Power currently entering the battery. Do not select a cumulative charged-energy counter.
data_description.discharge_power: Power currently leaving the battery for loads. Discharge is not automatically solar-origin energy.
data_description.soc: Current state of charge between 0 and 100%, not an energy reading in kWh.
data_description.remaining_energy: Optional: currently available stored energy in Wh/kWh. Do not select Total Grid Energy, daily energy, or lifetime charge/discharge counters. Leave empty without a suitable source. Declared cumulative counters are rejected; above capacity × 1.10, the association is flagged inconsistent.
data_description.remaining_energy_is_stock: Only confirm a real remaining stock misclassified by HA. Accepts Wh/kWh; capacity checks still apply. Lifetime consumed energy is unsuitable.
